key_insight: A privacy-preserving Llama 3.3 70B pipeline extracted oncology registry variables with high accuracy without task-specific fine-tuning.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support oncology registry abstraction while keeping identifiable patient data within hospital infrastructure.
method: Processed 6,700 oncology notes from a Singapore cancer centre to extract over 50 variables.
De-identified notes locally using a Hide-In-Plain-Sight approach.
Evaluated outputs as correct, missing, spurious, or incorrect against adjudicated ground truth.
evidence_signal: On 200 randomly sampled notes, F1 scores ranged from 88.1% for treatments to 97.2% for diagnosis; preliminary testing also included 50 external notes.
watch_item: External testing was small and showed reduced performance for list-valued variables, leaving broader generalizability uncertain.
paper_title: Privacy-Preserving Large Language Model Deployment for Oncology Registry Abstraction: Structure-Aware Evaluation in a Real-World Clinical Setting
